record.field: Greeting
The agent greets the customer, thanks them for calling and gives their name.
thank you for calling, thanks for calling, good morning, good afternoon, good evening, my name is
Identity verification
Before discussing the account, the agent verifies the caller's identity (e.g. date of birth, account number or last four digits).
verify, verification, date of birth, account number, last four, security question
Understanding the issue
The agent asks questions and repeats the issue back to confirm they understood it.
just to confirm, so you are saying, if i understand, can you tell me, let me make sure, what happened
Empathy & tone
The agent stays calm and polite and acknowledges the customer's feelings.
i understand, i'm sorry, i am sorry, i apologize, sorry for the, frustrating, i can imagine
Resolution
The agent solves the issue or gives a clear next step with a timeframe.
resolved, fixed, refund has been, processed, has been updated, you will receive
Compliance disclosures
The agent tells the customer the call may be recorded for quality and training.
this call may be recorded, recorded for quality, call is being recorded, monitored or recorded
Closing
The agent asks if there is anything else and closes the call politely.
anything else, have a great day, have a nice day, thank you for your time, thanks for your patience
